item.title: Rubbish obstructing an trance to the building and pavement, 25th August
item.description:
The condition at 13 Ashmere Grove has deteriorated considerably in recent weeks. A substantial amount of furniture, bedding, bags, refuse bins and other household items has been placed outside the front of the building, leaving the main entrance difficult to access. This problem has persisted for some time but now appears to be worsening, possibly because there is very little remaining space inside the property. The obstruction raises concerns about residents being able to enter or leave safely, particularly in the event of a fire or other emergency. There may also be wider public health, fire safety and environmental concerns. We would be grateful if Lambeth Council could investigate the matter and involve the relevant services where appropriate.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 50a, Hetherington Road, Stockwell, Greater London
